title: Broadway Vibes: Meet Me at Tootsies
description:
Muse | third-floor downtown condo with high-speed WiFi & central AC

The space
This charming condo’s bright and cheerful decor creates a fun and inviting atmosphere—can you spot all the horse-themed details? Stay cool with central air-conditioning as you unwind on the spacious corner sofa, perfect for sipping a refreshing drink. Grab a glass of bubbly from the mini-bar cart or mix up your favorite cocktail in the fully equipped kitchen, complete with full-size appliances and a breakfast bar that seats three. When it's time to rest, simply close the room-darkening shades for a peaceful night’s sleep. Need extra space? The sofa bed in the living area has you covered.

During your stay, you’ll also have access to a fitness room for added convenience.

MUSE AMENITIES

Rooftop lounge
Fitness center
Elevator in the building

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!

Other things to note
THINGS TO KNOW

- Streaming is available using your own accounts.
- No pets are allowed at this vacation rental.
- This rental is located on floor 3.
- Parking notes: No parking available.
- Guest entry instructions: This rental utilizes an E-lock, a digital lock that requires a unique code to enter. This code is reset after each guest's stay.
